name: load Vracov and open the generator (mocked Overpass data)
Apply writes all proposed turns on route points, one Undo step
eval: const n = gen.result.add.length; __T.apply(); await __T.wait(200); return { added: __T.types().length === n, onRoute: __T.onRoute(), undo: !btnUndo.disabled, dirty: gpx.dirty, wpts: locateWpts(gpx.text).length === n + 2, idxCount: (gpx.text.match(/waypointIndices>([^<]*)</)[1].split(',').length) === n + 2 }

name: Add missing again finds nothing new and reuses the cached network data
eval: await __T.open(); const r = { add: gen.result.add.length, calls: __overpass.calls }; closeGenerator(); return r

name: REGRESSION: delete 3 turns without saving → generator proposes exactly those 3 again
eval: window.__before = wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).map(w => w.type + '@' + w.el.getAttribute('lat')); const del = wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).slice(2, 5); window.__deleted = del.map(w => w.type + '@' + w.el.getAttribute('lat')).sort(); for (const w of [...del].sort((a, b) => b.order - a.order)) deleteWpt(w); const left = wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).length; await __T.open(); return { left, proposed: gen.result.add.map(c => c.type + '@' + trackLines[c.li].els[c.idx].getAttribute('lat')).sort(), deleted: __deleted, calls: __overpass.calls }

name: … and after Apply the file has the same turns as before deleting
eval: __T.apply(); await __T.wait(200); const now = wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).map(w => w.type + '@' + w.el.getAttribute('lat')); return { same: JSON.stringify(now) === JSON.stringify(__before) }

name: Replace all turns removes and recreates the same set
eval: await __T.open(); document.querySelector('#gen-card input[value=replace]').click(); await __T.wait(100); const r = { add: gen.result.add.length, remove: gen.result.remove.length }; __T.apply(); await __T.wait(200); r.same = JSON.stringify(wptItems.filter(w => !w.fixed).map(w => w.type + '@' + w.el.getAttribute('lat'))) === JSON.stringify(__before); r.equal = r.add === r.remove; return r

name: No two waypoints closer than the minimum spacing (15 m)
Undo of all steps restores the original file byte for byte
eval: const orig = await (await fetch(location.origin + '/samples/Vracov%205km.gpx')).text(); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !btnUndo.disabled; i++) btnUndo.click(); return { exact: gpx.text === orig, dirty: gpx.dirty }

name: Settings: larger angle / spacing propose fewer turns and are remembered
eval: await __T.open(); const base = gen.result.add.length; const inp = document.querySelectorAll('#gen-card input[type=number]'); inp[0].value = 45; inp[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const a45 = gen.result.add.length; inp[1].value = 300; inp[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); const s300 = gen.result.add.length; closeGenerator(); return { fewer45: a45 < base, fewer300: s300 <= a45, saved: localStorage.getItem('addturngpx.generator') }

name: REGRESSION: a larger spacing only removes proposals, never adds new ones
eval: await __T.open(); const inp = document.querySelectorAll('#gen-card input[type=number]'); const key = c => c.type + '@' + c.idx; const run = (a, sp) => { inp[0].value = a; inp[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); inp[1].value = sp; inp[1].dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return gen.result.add.map(key); }; const s15 = run(20, 15), s50 = run(20, 50), s300 = run(20, 300); closeGenerator(); localStorage.removeItem('addturngpx.generator'); return { subset50: s50.every(k => s15.includes(k)), subset300: s300.every(k => s50.includes(k)), counts: [s15.length, s50.length, s300.length] }

name: Overloaded server (200 + remark) is an error, not '0 junctions'
A failed answer is not cached: Try again succeeds once the server is back
eval: __overpass.mode = 'fixture'; [...document.querySelectorAll('#gen-card button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Try again').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && gen.loading; i++) await __T.wait(50); return { error: gen.error, found: gen.result.add.length > 0, calls: __overpass.calls }

name: REGRESSION: an empty answer (server glitch) is retried once automatically
eval: closeGenerator(); junctionCache = null; OVERPASS_RETRY_MS = 50; const c0 = __overpass.calls; __overpass.mode = 'emptyOnce'; await __T.open(); return { error: gen.error, calls: __overpass.calls - c0, found: gen.result.add.length > 0 }

name: REGRESSION: repeated empty answers → clear error with Try again, nothing cached
eval: closeGenerator(); junctionCache = null; const c0 = __overpass.calls; __overpass.mode = 'empty'; await __T.open(); const r = { error: (gen.error || '').includes('returned no roads or paths'), calls: __overpass.calls - c0, retry: [...document.querySelectorAll('#gen-card button')].some(b => b.textContent === 'Try again'), cached: junctionCache !== null }; return r

name: HTTP 429 → 'overloaded' message
eval: closeGenerator(); junctionCache = null; __overpass.mode = 'http429'; await __T.open(); return { error: (gen.error || '').includes('overloaded') }

name: No answer in time → timeout message
eval: closeGenerator(); OVERPASS_TIMEOUT_MS = 300; __overpass.mode = 'hang'; await __T.open(); return { error: (gen.error || '').includes('did not answer within') }

name: Changing the route (inserted route point) loads fresh network data
eval: closeGenerator(); OVERPASS_TIMEOUT_MS = 90000; __overpass.mode = 'fixture'; await __T.open(); const c1 = __overpass.calls; closeGenerator(); addWptAtTarget({ li: 0, seg: 2, t: 0.5 }); await __T.wait(200); await __T.open(); const r = { refetched: __overpass.calls === c1 + 1, error: gen.error }; closeGenerator(); return r
